history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Revises cinema-print timing, source illumination and channel contrast behavior. Existing edits may render differently.
changes: Corrects print-layer sensitivity and density targets.
Defaults source illumination to Stock Native, with daylight, tungsten and custom choices.
Separates source light, viewing illumination and print development.
Makes Channel Contrast Match optional and off by default while preserving saved nonzero settings.

history.summary: Improved film rendering, editing controls, and performance.  For Apple silicon Macs with macOS 14 or later. Download the installer for the Mac app and DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro plugins.
